concerns.text: Task T002 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it writes `__init__.py` files throughout the code tree. It shares the same directory hierarchy with T001 (scaffolding) and T003/T004 which also modify files in those directories. Running T002 in parallel with any of those tasks can cause race conditions or file‑write conflicts. Remove the `[P]` tag or enforce a strict ordering.

Task T003 is marked `[P]` yet it edits `requirements.txt`, a file also created/checked by T001 and potentially touched by other tasks (e.g., later dependency‑update steps). Parallel execution could lead to nondeterministic requirement lists. The `[P]` tag is unsafe; it should be sequential.

Task T004 creates `.ruff.toml` and `pyproject.toml`. These files are also referenced by T001 (which ensures they exist) and may be touched by other lint‑related tasks. Marking T004 as `[P]` is unsafe because concurrent writes to the same config files can corrupt them.

Task T007 modifies `config.py` to add environment‑variable constants. `config.py` is also created/initialised by T004c (Config module). Parallel execution of T004c and T007 could result in overlapping writes and lost constants. The `[P]` tag should be removed.

Task T016b implements `BatchExecutor` and is marked `[P]`. Task T016c adds a `TimeoutGuard` decorator to the same module. If both are run in parallel, the decorator may be added before the executor class is fully defined, causing import errors. The `[P]` tag is unsafe; enforce sequential ordering.

Task T026a (Quantized model loader) is `[P]` but it writes model‑loading logic that is later extended by T026b (memory‑pressure handling) and T026c (ModelRunner). Parallel execution could lead to incomplete or inconsistent loader definitions. Remove `[P]`.
Task T026b adds RAM‑check logic to the quantization module created by T026a. As with T026a, parallel execution risks partial updates. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T026c wraps the loader from T026a/b into `ModelRunner`. It depends on both prior tasks being completed. Parallel execution with T026a/b could cause undefined references. `[P]` should be removed.

Task T044 reads `state/quantization_penalty.json` produced by T042. Although T042 is in Phase 0, the `[P]` tag on T044 could allow it to run before T042 finishes if the scheduler does not enforce phase ordering. Ensure T044 is scheduled after T042; the `[P]` tag is misleading.

Task T048 (hypothetical placeholder) – if any other task in Phase 2 or later modifies the same artifact as a prior task while being marked `[P]`, the same race‑condition risk applies. Review all `[P]` tags for shared‑artifact writes.
